# Add a source {.topic-h1}

Paste a link to an article, a lesson or a documentation page. The Carnet IA agent reads it, researches what's missing, and proposes a plan for you to approve before anything is written.
:::

```{=html}
<form class="source-form" id="source-form" action="https://github.com/SalouaAifqui/carnet-ia/issues/new" method="get" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
  <input type="hidden" name="template" value="new-source.yml">
  <input type="hidden" name="title" id="source-title" value="Source: ">

  <label for="source-url">URL</label>
  <input type="url" id="source-url" name="url" required placeholder="https://…" autocomplete="off">

  <label for="source-notes">Notes for the agent <span class="optional">(optional)</span></label>
  <textarea id="source-notes" name="notes" rows="3" placeholder="e.g. focus on the code, put it in Guardrails"></textarea>

  <button type="submit">Open on GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></button>
  <p class="form-help">GitHub opens with the issue already filled in. Click <strong>Create</strong> there, and the agent posts its plan on the issue a few minutes later.</p>
</form>

<ol class="steps" aria-label="What happens next">
  <li><strong>Plan</strong><span>The agent reads the page, looks for missing context, and posts a plan on the issue.</span></li>
  <li><strong>You approve</strong><span>Reply <code>/approve</code>, <code>/replan …</code> with instructions, or <code>/cancel</code>.</span></li>
  <li><strong>Pull request</strong><span>The agent writes and reviews the page, then opens a pull request.</span></li>
  <li><strong>Published</strong><span>Merge it and the page goes live.</span></li>
</ol>

<script>
  // The issue title shows the domain, so the issue list stays readable.
  document.getElementById("source-form").addEventListener("submit", function () {
    var url = document.getElementById("source-url").value.trim();
    var label = url;
    try { var u = new URL(url); label = u.hostname.replace(/^www\./, "") + u.pathname.replace(/\/$/, ""); } catch (e) {}
    document.getElementById("source-title").value = "Source: " + label.slice(0, 120);
  });
</script>
```
